items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the correction of Malchut not through ZA? The Mochin of the Nukva are the aspect of an offshoot of the Mochin of ZA, by a special coupling made in the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of the Mazal of ZA. And those Mochin clothe in the NHY of ZA, which became Mochin in the head of the Nukva. However, for the building of her Partzuf, she needs to receive from the Mochin of the Mazal, which are drawn from the upper Aba and Ima, and she receives them in the NHY of Ima themselves, and not in the NHY of ZA; and this is called the correction of Malchut not through ZA. See well above in Answers 6 and 7. (Item 174).
